reflection.delta: The completed implementation lacked an independent constraint-by-constraint QA disposition and persistent refiner state. This cycle adds both. It found no new implementation defect, but archive certification and npm publication remain unproven.

constraint_evaluation.notes: Every plan/OpenSpec criterion maps to a retained receipt or focused validator.
The external app installs only two local rc.1 tarballs; workspace source is not counted.
Twelve unique request graphs, zero client refetches/errors, mutation, realtime, transition, and reload assertions pass.
The screenshot and both traces match recorded hashes; serious and critical axe counts are zero.
Coverage, 203 exports, skills, docs, OpenSpec, Changesets, and evidence agree.
Browser/rendering/live/platform exclusions and frozen React rc.1 separation are explicit.
Server Action input is allowlisted and resolved from server-owned data; denial and audit gates pass.
The bundle certifies only bounded implementation readiness and preserves fixed-group/protected staging policy.

reflection.deterministic_validation: All ten packed verifier commands have exit code zero; 12/12 request graphs, 2/2 browser tests, 3/3 visual artifacts, 203 exports, 13/13 semantic scenarios, 14/14 coverage regressions, strict OpenSpec, security, and evidence predicates pass.
reflection.target_alignment: The Next.js implementation can proceed to adversarial review without entering the frozen React rc.1 source or claiming full release completion.
reflection.regression_check: No runtime source changed during QA, no evidence was removed, no severity was downgraded, and both manifest outputs are non-empty.

convergence.reason: All eight blocking constraints have direct evidence and no material correction remains.
convergence.next_focus: Run isolated adversarial diff review, then OpenSpec verify/archive only on PASS.
